decisions.reason: Offshore vessel management is very close to the firm's core shipmanagement capabilities, so a large German maritime services firm would likely use its existing knowledge to refine rather than exit the offer.

Crew and corporate travel management is a related extension of crewing and logistics know-how, and despite uncertain recent market conditions the firm can interpret early results through its existing customer relationships and operational experience.

An online vessel information portal fits the firm's established vessel data and client-service base, giving it enough absorptive capacity to improve the product and embed it in broader service offerings.

Although vessel performance knowledge is related to the core business, a standalone mobile app is the most vulnerable to weak uptake or integration into other digital products, so management would be relatively likely to discontinue it as a separate market offer.
